options = webdriver.EdgeOptions()
    anchor = config.get('_window_anchor')
    if (not config.get('headless', False)
            and isinstance(anchor, (list, tuple)) and len(anchor) == 4
            and all(type(value) is int for value in anchor)
            and anchor[2] > anchor[0] and anchor[3] > anchor[1]):
        try:
            from ..window_placement import beside_rect, monitors
            x, y, width, height = beside_rect(anchor, monitors(), 1100, 800)
            options.add_argument(f'--window-position={x},{y}')
            options.add_argument(f'--window-size={width},{height}')
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError):
            pass
